Please read [SECURITY](../../SECURITY.md) before reporting a sensitive vulnerability. Do not include private data.

## Environment

- Zinn commit and exact `zig version`:
- Host OS/architecture:
- Target/model/weight format:

## Reproduction

Minimal input/model, exact commands/options, expected and actual output. Include all logits when applicable; distinguish host, simulation, cross-build and physical execution.

## Resources and verification

Attach memory report/stack allowance if relevant. For hardware include board/package/clock/firmware identity and wiring. Report tests run and any differences from unmodified examples.
